<!-- pr-reviewer: a3dfa5e6ead85193b401713b8d3e1b2e8cce6cc4 -->
Cannot merge with current main: two files conflict. No code defect was found in the tested trial merge.

The input checks, separate healing bound, and strict kerf checks on both planes look correct. The new tests cover corners, fillets, slots, invalid values, and both widening modes.

Local build and test results:

The PR was trial-merged with main at `3970d3d0319e423761c48f9a7e0a6391a14b9403`. No runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 660 steps passed; 0 failed |
| Quick test totals | motion: 470 passed; app: 3995 passed; post: 712 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | All reached motion and app heavy lanes ran; 217 steps passed; 0 failed |
| Heavy test totals | motion: 56 passed; app: 42 passed |
| Registered known-failure checks | Both failed at the expected assertions; the gate accepted both results |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

No extra fixture or importer suites were required. This diff changes no fixture, golden directory, or import code. The quick gate also ran `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join` and the wire integration suites.

Safety mutation checks:

- Disabled the `heal_tolerance` input check. `zero_heal_tolerance_preserves_existing_refusals_and_door_rejects_bad_values` failed with exit 101.
- Replaced the healing upper bound with infinity. `excesses_above_heal_tolerance_refuse_with_spot_depth_and_bound` failed with exit 101.
- Restored both edits. All six `wire_edm::ruled_heal_tests` passed. No mutation edit remains.

No goldens moved. No UI file changed, so before/after screenshots were not required.

Required before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs:355`: Resolve the test-module conflict with current main. Keep both the healing tests and main's preimage tests.
2. `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/ruled_widen.rs:36`: Resolve the import conflict with current main. Keep the healing report and main's preimage behavior. Run the gates and lint again after the branch refresh.

Main changed during the local checks. A final merge simulation against `06d349391` found these conflicts. The green results above apply to the tested main snapshot, not to a resolution of the new conflicts. The PR stays a draft with the `conflicts` label.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Resolved the `wire_edm/mod.rs` conflict. Kept both the healing and preimage test modules, each under `#[cfg(test)]`.
   Both pin names appear in test discovery. Removing the healing module failed the discovery check. Removing the preimage test module failed compilation. Restored discovery passed.
2. Resolved the `ruled_widen.rs` import conflict. Kept the healing report and preimage behavior. Removed obsolete imports.
   Existing behavioral pins cover this merge:
   - `tight_inside_corners_heal_within_heal_tolerance`: disabling per-ruling healing failed with exit 101. Restoring it passed.
   - `per_ruling_arc_length_sews_an_asymmetric_trimmed_fillet_as_a_fan`: replacing preimage sewing with the old pairing failed with exit 101. Restoring it passed.

These conflicts changed declarations and imports only. The existing pins cover both retained behaviors, so no new test was needed.

Merged `upstream/main` at `cced2e6fd`. Only the two reported files needed conflict resolution. All mutation edits were restored.

Validation on the new head:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 581 steps passed; 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

New head: `51da4cb016d077c84e977e22516f6f5b8407d948`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft. No labels were changed.
